name: micromart-application
description: This project is a microservices architecture built using Express.js and MongoDB. It consists of four main services: Product Service, Order Service, Inventory Service, and User Service. Each service is responsible for a specific domain and communicates with each other to provide a complete solution.

scripts.start:all: npm run start:user-service & npm run start:product-service & npm run start:order-service & npm run start:inventory-service
